children: Here’s a challenge. Using the five clues below, identify the company that is being talked about here.
1 My founder was an inventor and industrialist. I came under Indian ownership around the time of our Independence and changed control several years thereafter.
2 I came out of a difficult situation after a turnaround specialist became my MD and CEO. His book on my turnaround is a good read.
3 My chairman and nearly half of my seven-member board graduated from IIT Madras.
4 I have been part of all three indices — small-cap, mid-cap and large-cap — within five years. Currently, my market capitalisation is thrice that of my controlling shareholder.

5 I have delivered strong returns to shareholders, backed by more than 25 per cent annual earnings growth over the past one, five and 10 years, and doubled my shareholder base in the last three years.

title: Who Am I? October 25, 2026
